content.value: Consider an aluminum hollow sphere of inside radius $r _ { 1 } = 2 c m$ , outside radius $r _ { 2 } = 6$ cm and thermal conductivity $K = 2 0 0 W / ( m . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } )$ . The inside radius surface is kept at an uniform temperature $T _ { i } = 1 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and outside surface dissipates heat by convection with a heat transfer co-efficient $h _ { \alpha } = 8 0 W / ( m ^ { 2 } . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } )$ into the ambient air at temperature $T _ { \alpha } = 2 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ Determine the outside surface temperature of the sphere and the rate of heat transfer from the sphere.
